hero.subtitle: Blue Horizon Minerals Ltd connects mineral deposits in the Democratic Republic of Congo to international markets — gold, coltan, copper and cobalt, delivered with rigor and transparency.

about.title: A trusted partner in the mineral trade
about.paragraph1: Blue Horizon Minerals Ltd is a company specializing in the sale and international trade of minerals. We work with reliable partners and suppliers to offer quality minerals and facilitate their commercialization on international markets.
about.paragraph2: Based in the Democratic Republic of Congo, we support producers and buyers at every step, from sourcing to connecting with international partners.
